attempts.summary: Created an SSH CA on node1 (/etc/ssh/ca, /etc/ssh/ca.pub), signed the host's ed25519 public key into /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub, and configured sshd with HostCertificate pointing at it. Verified with a client that trusts only the CA public key (@cert-authority in known_hosts, no pinned host key) that the connection validates the certificate and proceeds to authentication. Completed the mandatory single-node restart of node1: captured baseline boot_id/config, rebooted, confirmed boot_id changed, and reverified sshd active, the certificate persisted, and the CA-trust connection still succeeds.
